title: Replace SRD free-text choice filters
description:
Replace free-text SRD choice sources with structured deterministic filters.

Problem:
Some choices are modeled as choices but still use free-text sources such as:
- "the wizard spell list"
- "the bard spell list"
- "your skill proficiencies"

These are discoverable by the primary DM model but weak for deterministic tools. Tools should not parse English to determine allowed choices.

Scope:
- Find choice records where from/source/filter is a plain string but could be represented as a typed filter.
- Convert spell and cantrip choice sources to structured spellFilter objects.
- Convert character-state-dependent choices, such as expertise from existing skill proficiencies, into typed characterStateFilter-style objects.
- Add guardrails so future importer changes do not reintroduce string filters for deterministic choice domains.
- Preserve source prose separately for DM context.

Acceptance criteria:
- Spell/cantrip choices use structured spell filters with class list and level constraints.
- Character-state choices use structured filters rather than prose like "your skill proficiencies".
- Any remaining string from/source values are explicitly justified as DM-only prose or unknown/unresolved.
- New tests or audit gates catch spell/cantrip choices with string filters.
- npm run typecheck passes.
- npm test passes.
- npm run check passes.
- npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack passes and regenerated pack output is intentional.
